description: Aigine Redact v2.4.9: Detects and masks personal data (GDPR, including Art. 9 special categories, using contextual PID clustering) and confidential information (trade secrets, procurement tenders, FOIA exemptions, and statutory secrecy such as Swedish OSL) in PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and image documents using non-generative encoder classifiers on EU GPUs (98.30% precision, 93.17% recall, 95.67% F1; 10.8s median latency; strict zero retention). Returns download_url for a flattened PDF with irreversible masks burned in, or review_url when interactive web GUI review is enabled. Free tier: watermarked PDF, 100 documents/day per daily-salted IP hash.

file_url.description: Direct HTTPS URL of the source document to mask.

policy.description: Redaction policy: 'Privacy' (GDPR personal data, default), 'Secrecy' (trade secrets and statutory secrecy/OSL), or 'Privacy and Secrecy' (both).

require_human_review.description: When true, prepares an interactive web GUI review session (review_url) before generating the final PDF. When false (default), generates the masked PDF directly.

upload_id.description: Temporary upload ID representing a file uploaded to the EU server.

name: propose_masking
title: Mask Document – GDPR / Secrecy (v2.4.9)
